# Farsio

> Farsio (فارسیو) is a Persian-first AI product ecosystem for writing, reading, speech, translation and language productivity.

Canonical website: https://farsio.ir/
Persian: https://farsio.ir/fa
English: https://farsio.ir/en

Machine-readable entity graph:
https://farsio.ir/ai-entities.json

Machine-readable AI discovery graph:
https://farsio.ir/ai-discovery.json

## Products

### NeveshtYar · نوشت‌یار
Persian-first writing assistant for:
- Persian writing
- Finglish to Persian conversion
- Persian and English keyboard-layout recovery
- text editing and rewriting
- Persian language productivity

Current public release: v4.9.2
Current stage: browser-store readiness and continued quality hardening

Persian:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/neveshtyar

English:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/neveshtyar

Release notes and roadmap:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/neveshtyar#release-notes
https://farsio.ir/en/products/neveshtyar#release-notes

### AvaYar · آوایار
Persian-first reading and speech assistant for:
- reading web content
- Full Text and Summary modes
- English-to-Persian preparation
- real Persian neural text-to-speech
- female Sulafat and male Iapetus voices
- progressive audio playback
- Play, Pause, Resume and Stop controls
- listening workflows

Current public release: 0.6.0 Stable
Current stage: browser-accepted Stable release; browser-store distribution readiness, privacy/permission hardening and online-runtime reliability

Persian:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/avayar

English:
https://farsio.ir/en/products/avayar

Release notes and roadmap:
https://farsio.ir/fa/products/avayar#release-notes
https://farsio.ir/en/products/avayar#release-notes

Official Stable release:
https://github.com/FarsioIR/AvaYar/releases/tag/avayar-v0.6.0

## Product status as of 2026-09-10

NeveshtYar v4.9.2:
- Chrome acceptance 15/15 PASS
- Firefox acceptance 15/15 PASS
- 193/193 deterministic tests PASS
- extension-store audit PASS
- Chromium, Firefox and Mozilla reviewer-source artifacts published

AvaYar 0.6.0 Stable:
- browser-accepted Chrome/Edge Stable package published
- English-to-Persian preparation PASS
- real Persian neural TTS PASS
- female Sulafat voice PASS
- male Iapetus voice PASS
- Summary + Full Text browser acceptance PASS
- progressive playback PASS
- Play/Pause/Resume/Stop PASS
- canonical Stable ZIP SHA-256: b3cb4265b5d9bb13e5bc0d6f9f726ca716270a0d692d29706f4e7596077ed375

GitHub is the technical provenance source. Each Farsio product page is the canonical public, user-facing product history and roadmap.
